title: Metropolis
description: A Paper 26.2/26.3 city-planning plugin that turns player onboarding into procedural urban growth with protected UUID-owned homes, roads, reservations, and configurable infrastructure.

image.url: Pixel-art aerial view of a growing Minecraft city planned in a square grid, small player home plots connected by pale roads, a protected central spawn, blocky green landscape, subtle WorldGuard-inspired boundary lines, warm daylight, clean game-plugin thumbnail composition, no words or logos.
